review_text: I love this place especially their pork buns hahaha  oh there is a cutie here who dressed up as a Sailor Mars on halloween, i thought he was a actual girl wow lol
love this place! the greeting you receive as you enter the main restaurant is a cool energetic welcome, and the food is just made with love and has a great variety on the menu.

I have to Say I Love Just Plain Dave's. Always a great meal for a Great Price . Love the New location cause its Closer to me LOL. and the interior of the new place is very nice as well. GREAT FOOD!!!!!!!!!
The size is really great and $6 for mixed chicken and gyro is really a deal. Always the long line but moves pretty fast. Worth a try.
best grandma slice period!
The ramen is pretty good but the appetizers are the stars of the show.
The wait is worth it, not just for the lovely ramen but also the fun atmosphere. Just request a table 1 hour before your intended dinner time and go to a nearby bar to have an aperitif. Enjoy!
Great food, long line, yet I was mostly impressed by its good service.
The atmosphere is awesome and the ramen is fantastic!

Got a white large pizza with ricotta ham and fresh mozzarella and fresh garlic it was amazingggggggg with a cream soda on the side and a cannoli for dessert loved it minus one star because there was like 5 flys that kept hovering over us but food wise it was amazinggg
Delicious and great service

how about going to 99 cents creations at 149 W 24st NY N Y 10011 between 6th and 7th ave in Chelsea area. on the north side of the street.  Best 99 cents store ever come and check it out, every thing for every body.
Great place, the bartender is amazing, drinks are delicious!!!! Yummy.... I truly recommend this place, great Peruvian food and drinks.....
All the time I walk by this place I feel like buying a meal even if I'm full that's how good these guys are. This is the freshest halal food off the street you would get in NYC. It is addicting !!
Karakamen and green tea creme brûlée.  Next time I want to try the traditional classic ramen.
Tourist trap
Pizza was thick and tasted alright. Didn't really enjoy their spumoni however the strawberry ice cream tasted amazing!!
mmm authentic Philly cheesesteaks

WORST service I have ever encountered.... I'm new here from Miami looking for a yummy Chinese spot I order out 3-4x a week...I have ordered a few times. First time they delivered and refused to bring it up to my door. Mind you I have a 90 y/o grandmother I take care of... When I told then to please bring it up the guy rudely huffed and complained. Next time I ordered for pick up. Fast service... Now today I call for delivery again and the guy says "I have to come down to get the food". I tell him my situation again then he hangs up on me. I called back several times and finally got him on the phone and told him I would come downstairs and he rudely said "NO, NO delivery for you now" when I asked if he was the owner or manager he said he was neither of those but he didn't care no delivery and hung up on me again. I called back again and told him I would pick it up and he said if I'm only ordering one thing then don't bother to order..... I was in shock at how rude they could be. I will never give this business my money again they are rude and nasty ill mannered people... They should change workers might get more business. Disgusting person answering the phone he should be FIRED!!!!!!!!!!

After much anticipation we tried Anthony's take out only. Three times in two weeks!! The first time I ordered the famous wings & the lunch chicken sandwich with roasted peppers, arugala n fresh mozzarella. Wings were great sandwich was also delicious a lot of the stuff on it that over powered the chicken. We also noticed that the chicken was very unevenly distributed more on one side so we had to adjust. It still needed more chicken to satisfy the amount of other stuff. I was also asked if I wanted to try the awning pick up?? Which means u pull up on the side by the black awning n they come out n deliver your order to you....well of course I said yes! Upon arrival I waited for a good 8 min I was in a hurry so I thought well they must not know I'm here! So I went in!! . Just an FYI...take out order #2.... Well this was a real doozy!!! Ordered a small pizza 12" IAsked for 1/2 mushroom 1/2 prosciutto,and an Anthony's favorite sandwich from the lunch side ( consisting of fresh mozzarella,prosciutto, arugala and fresh tomato on focaccia bread.) again they ask about awning pick up I say yes in hope that they will come out btw this is around 5/6 at night. So I pull up n wait about 4 min...two girls  comes out!! They tell me it's like 15$ or so....so I tell them I think you have the wrong order , my cost should be more around $20 ish. So she says oh that's because we gave you a lunch size pizza! Why? Well because we don't do half and half on pies!!!! REALLY?? So you gave me as a lunch pizza? Yes with mushroom!! And a side of proscuitto !!! I'm like your kidding right? I tell her go back in and see if you can just get me a plain lunch pie and I will put the proscuitto on myself. She comes back hands me my order and says nope they don't have one. I'm thinking who decided to make this executive decision? I asked y didn't u call? Couldn't find your #!!! Well then next best thing...just give the customer what they asked for and suck it up!! Nope....so I Leave very pissed bc I got two grown kids and myself to feed with a pie the size of a dinner plate and a sandwich that when I get home has hardly any mozzarella on it....they must have an arugala garden somewhere bc again I got a lot of arugala like the first sandwich but not much of the other stuff!! Wow I was so disappointed and hungry to!  1,2,3 strikes your out. So we try again, this time my hubby orders a large pie with sausage and onion and a plain pie. He gets home and says wow guess how much for two pies? 39.99!!!! I said what the heck you got gold on it? NO....just two toppings ....but Anthony's charges 2.99 for the first one and 1.99 thereafter!! Would not be so bad if they actually gave you the toppings to make it worthy...but talk about skimping!! And the crust was burnt!! A. Big no no in my book. Listen, I have had pizza in many places including Italy. NYC, and the famous Wooster street in new haven, ct!! You want to talk about outrageous pizza!! Try it one day!!Peppis is awesome...and Tollis in East Haven!  The pie is good I'll give them that but it's not worth the price they charge! Sorry...flour,water,sauce cheese....it's not justifiable in my book. You r paying for the high end coal oven and the liquor license!  I think I'll stick to bradlees pizza it's worth every $1.00!!!!! She gives you a Pie with sausage on it not a few crumbs scattered on!!! Staff needs to know how to figure out different situations....and the #1 thing..never let the customer go home without  making the situation better then it was!!
Amazing!!! Wish we had this in the DC area but kinda glad we don't because I'd weigh like 300lbs ^.^ Skip the red sauce and overdo the white sauce!

I did a little bar hopping for the football games yesterday. Ended up here to watch the Dallas game and finally eat some food. My first impression, what a great place To watch the games. I loved the atmosphere. Very detailed down to the bathrooms! Big TV's all over as well. (I-phone chargers at every bar seat) We sat at the bar and ordered a bunch of appetizers.   Nachos..delish! Crab and spinach dip.. Delish! Quesadillas... Delish! The people next to me had the lamb burger and sliders which I wish I ordered had I not stuffed my face with all the apps. It looked SO good! The bartender was friendly and made me the best "old fashioned" I have ever had. I will definitely be coming back to Founding Fathers! Except next time I will bring more of my friends!

Upon a vacation visit to NYC, my girlfriend and I stayed a nite with a friend in Montclair. He insisted we had to go to Cuban Pete's, stating matter of factly that it is the one place you should go to when visiting Montclair. It may in fact be the best food in Montclair, but we never got that far into the meal due to some incredibly unprofessional restaurant staff and poor management. We headed over there about 8:30p on a Sunday. When we got inside, the manager asked us if we'd like to sit inside or outside. It was crowded inside and about 60's ish outside so we decided it would be better to eat outside. He told us we could sit anywhere and someone would be right with us with menus. There were two hostesses on staff. The first hostess we encountered not only did not give us menus after 15mins of sitting there, but threw us major shade each of the five times or so she passed by us. A busser came by to ask if we had been helped and said he'd get us some one, which also never happened. We quickly surmised that the staff was pissed we were sitting outside. Even though they offered us the option, we were the only ones out there and clearly the hostess/wait staff was not into it. Eventually the second hostess did drop us some menus, after 20 mins of sitting there. Still no water or set ups and she dropped the menus at our table with major angst. At this point, the buddy I'm staying with is in absolute shock at what's happening. And, since every one at the table has worked in the restaurant business, we are becoming seriously concerned that even if we did get to order, our food was gonna be....ummm....'sabotaged' is a polite word to use. The disdain from the staff was that palpable. We start to consider leaving when the coup de gras of the encounter occurrs. The manager comes out and asks 'Are you sure you folks don't wanna eat inside?'. I immediately shoot up from my chair and say 'YES! PLEASE! FINE! LET'S GO!'. He's taken aback by my response and offers a ridiculously passive aggressive suggestion: 'No No No, it's fine, you can sit out here if you want. No problems.' WHAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!? We got up and walked out stunned, annoyed, and really hungry. Luckily there was an OUTSTANDING Peruvian place around the corner that I couldn't recommend more (Costanera). I don't know about Montclair, but staff gets fired toot sweet over stuff like this in SF. The idea of staff picking and choosing where and when they want to work is ridiculous by any standard. This whole thing could have been avoided if they had said from the beginning 'There is no outside seating tonight'. We would have been totally content eating inside. But the AWFUL attitude of both hostesses and poor management completely turned a routine meal into a shit fest. I visit the Tri State area regularly and will likely be back to visit my friend in Montclair. But with all the good restaurants in the area, I won't even remotely consider returning to Cuban Pete's for a second chance.
Some of the best margarita in NYC!
Best wings ever! They also have the friendliest staff and owners. I have never had anything less than a great time at CJ's!!!
My fav place to get ramen- add an avocado its an excellent addition to any bowl!

Terrible experience here very rude bitchy servers don't recommend this place to No One !!!!!!! Got sat down no menus were given to us no silverware nothing nothing terrible service from beginning to finish was very poor ......1 star for good pizza customer service should be a priority !!!

If I could give this place no stars I would! Went in yesterday with a group of 3 people after a long day of shopping in NJ, thought I'd stop in before heading back to Manhattan. I had my little 3 lb Pomeranian puppy with me in a bag hidden and put away. It was a Sunday and not crowded at all maybe 5 people in the whole diner. The waitress who has HUGE holes in her ear called "gages" sees my puppy and even makes a comment on how it's cute he is. We order drinks and food. 15 mins later the waitress comes back and says "you can't have dogs in here", I was like are you kidding me you saw 15 mins ago that I had this dog with me. She then got a manager. This basically Jersey looking housewife nasty women who has no idea how to run a business came up to me and said "you can't have dogs in here it's a health hazard, you can leave him in the car! Mind you that is is 90 degrees outside so my in car temperature would be well over 120 degrees if not more. I bring this to her attention and she suggests that I am wrong and the dog would be just fine in the car. I tell her then that I would just like to pay for my drinks and leave. The owner/manager then basically says "NO, you have to pay for your food and you can take it to go"! I tell her "no no no" that's not how it works, I should only pay for it if I have actually received my food and started eating it. She then walks away and has the waitress bring me the full bill of like $40 bucks and the waitress who obviously doesn't want to deal with any confrontation slams the bill on the table and runs away. I leave cash for only the drinks and extra for a tip and leave. The owners son then runs outside as I am in my car about to pull away and starts writing down my plates!!!! ARE YOU KIDDING ME? He even stands behind my car not wanting me to leave. I slam my hand on my horn and he moves just a little bit out of the way while he takes pictures of my car as I pull away. All in all, I will never return. It was by far the worst dining experience I have ever had! I was threatened, treated like crap and harassed. If there are any animal lovers out there I would skip this place or just anyone who wants to go to a place and be treated fairly. Why give your business to a place that treats people like this. The owner is unprofessional and unapologetic. This all could have been fixed by her coming up to me and letting me know that she was sorry I was seated when I shouldn't have had a dog with me. And I would have paid for my drinks like I did and went on my way, but for her to FORCE me to pay for food I never got was beyond me and then to take it to the  extreme of having me followed out to the parking lot and having someone stand behind my car took it to a whole other level! WILL NEVER BE BACK!
Our server was Alexis she was amazing make sure you request your immediately when you get there
Great ramen and great atmosphere. Be ready to wait for 1h any day of the week, but at least they call you when your table is almost ready, so you can go wait wherever you want.
Always a must when in Center City Philly

New location is a definite improvement to the old one & the food is just as good. We thought the menu was more streamlined for the appropriate meal and we hope this change helps the efficiency of the place so they can stay around for a long time!

Went here on Saturday night with a few friends that live in the area.  Food was GREAT!! 1.  Chicken wings, healthy and crispy, baked in the oven with rosemary, you could eat a lot of them and not feel like your cheating on your diet!! 2.  Prosciutto  and Mozz.....enough said, I'm a sucker for prosciutto! 3. PIZZA PIZZA PIZZA!  We got a sampling with extras to spare to take home, ---white   pizza with truffle and mushroom THIS is a must, AMAZING!  ----margarita (I like the sauce) -----pesto with fresh tomatoes.  Pizza was crispy and a good ratio of sauce/cheese.  You can ask for well done for extra crispy too!! Lots of drink choices, I had a cucumber martini, very good.  And good wine list! Everyone was very nice and welcoming when I first arrived.  Being from New York and loving Grimaldis pizza I was excited to try the new restaurant.  I was surprised at how big the restaurant was, and liked that there was a separate bar area, will be good if you needed to bring kids and didn't want to be near others drinking!   In the main dining room I loved the mural of New York, it really made me reminisce about the area and where the original Grimaldis is! I will certainly be back!!!

I went to this place and the owner and his family were there speaking Italian so I thought for sure the food would be excellent but boy was I wrong!!!  I had a meatball calzone and a cold antipasto they were both unexceptable I left and ran to get zantac!! I can't see this  Italian family eating the food they serve to there customers which really upset me cause I am also Italian!  BOTTOM LINE THIS PLACE IS A INSULT TO ITALIANS DONT GO THERE!!!!!

This food cart hit the right spot in many ways.  The hype is true in my opinion.  One rice bowl order is enough for two people.  The server work fast, so don't bother talking as they are hustling and bustling.
it's fucking good

After a drink or two this is my favorite spot to stop by. Sometimes the lines are long at night because the food is great but it moves fast. Many people eat the food near the cart and it is really fun
Delicious, large portions, get the mixed chicken and lamb. Great tasting especially on a drunk night after the club lol!
Food is so delicious!!!! The best pizza I had in a very very long time!!!! Highly recommended!!!!

We stopped for dinner last night we went to the counter & was told to sit any where but the other room was cooler. It wasn't but the server was very nice I asked for a diet Pepsi I told him I saw a bottle in the fridge when we came. We sat and waited a long time for our soda & when it came I said this is diet Pepsi not Foxon Park oh he said I'm sorry he left for another long time & came back with I believe was the same soda  & I said this is diet Pepsi? Yes he said we took a bottle out of the fridge for you. I took a sip went up to the counter pointed at the bottle of Pepsi & said I would like that bottle of diet Pepsi . The man behind the counter said you can't have that it's for delivery customers!!!! WHAT! I'm a paying customer but I can't have a diet Pepsi! Give me a break if you happen to get so many delivery orders ( after 7:00 pm), why don't you just walk over to Krougers and pick some up? I got my grinder which was nothing special & washed it down with ice water. There are so many great pizza places in the area I don't need to go back there.
As good as it gets! without a doubt a gem in the area.
Delicious!

COCKROACH !!!! I went with my friends to this restaurant for first time with a groupon, we had the worst experience of our lives, I found a cockroach in the paella !!!!!! We wanted to throw up, worst experience ever !!!!! I don't care if it's for free ...don't eat there.
Pretty good but the chicken tastes like cardboard.  I'd rather go to another cart in NYC and not wait in the long line of tourists.
the cuban food here is amazing! . b.y.o.b.
Heaven in a slice. No sense in getting wordy with all these excellent reviews. Come for the Sicilian, leave with some Spumoni!

Caveat: This review is based on a single visit, so perhaps I was lucky. I visited the kiosk near the C130 gates. I was really craving a good latte. I didn't know the Worldbean banner before. I was a bit skeptical due to the few bad reviews here and the general bad coffee in airports. But seeing the Synesso machine and the naked portafilter convinced me of trying it anyway -- it takes some skill to use a naked portafilter, and I would see right away if they were doing something wrong. The lady who prepared my latte definately knew what she was doing. I saw her doing a proper tamp, the pull was a little quick but still within an acceptable range, and she didn't burn the milk. She even did a nice rosetta while pouring the microfoam. I'm very picky with my lattes, it was not spectacular, but it was good and well appreciated.
Best pizza in the land of pizza.  The Spumoni is great to boot.

This place is AMAZING!!!!! I am so happy that there is a spot like this right in my town!!! FINALLY!!!!!! The crepes and paninis are DELICIOUS!!!!!! They have both food and dessert crepes!!!!! They have juices with no additives -- just fruits and veggies!! My FAV is the pineapple/spinach!!  The ORGANIC COFFEE is to die for!!!! I am a bit of a coffee connoisseur and the espresso is heavenly!!!!! On top of having all of this amazing food, the owner and his awesome girl are soooo friendly and down to Earth!! He really strives on perfection and goes the distance to make everyone happy and feel at home.  Come and get a taste of perfection at 3rd Wave in Lyndhurst!! They open till midnight tonight!!! That's another great thing!! I will be there after my Zumba class to refuel!!! Woo hoo!! ENJOY!!! I know you will!!!!
The price of these dumplings helps me be prosperous. Trust me on this - get a pancake.

Great selection that goes beyond your typical brunch staples. I had the shrimp hue is rancheros and it was awesome. It's a cute place with plenty of space, you're not too crowded. And on a Sunday at 11:30 we only had to wait about 15 minutes for a table! Good coffee too!

Balthazar, and all the McNally restaurants have long been at the top of our list, and we have been to them all. We returned for lunch and had a wonderful time. We were seated at one of our favorite banquettes, and the staff couldn't have been more attentive or friendlier. The food was as always, fantastic. Great oysters, escargot, duck shepherd's pie and their incredible lamb sandwich paired with a great bottle of Chablis.

If you can stand the lines, or get there when it isn't crowded, the Halal Guys is absolutely delicious! For $6-8, you get a big plate of rice, lettuce, and perfectly cooked schwarma meat or falafel. This is not only how food stands should be done, but how middle eastern food should be done in this city. Not to mention, the guys are very nice, and will make your food any way you want it. Yeah, the lines are long, but the lines are long for a reason.

Basso56 was very crowded with the theatre crowd. The food was great, especially the past with the lighter sauces- cream and butter dishes... the red sauce with bacon on the fusili was just ok.. Would go there again -appetizers and desserts were excellent!
A small group of friends met for brunch here. The food was excellent and the staff was super friendly. Even though I had never been here before I was treated like I was one of the regulars.

Great food at great prices but the service is horrible. I return here every now and then only for the food. The food gets 4 stars and service gets 1. If you don't care about service you will enjoy the restaurant, but if service is important to you, steer clear.

The food at snack is a selection of popular Greek dishes. The appetizer tray is good as is the Greek salad. We were underwhelmed with the main courses. There are 4-5 tables here so it's sometimes hard to get seated.
This is a small place with an incredible vibe. The food is fantastic. I had the chefs tasting menu and every dish was on point. A must try!

t's very small but in a cosy way that was just perfect. Lovely staff and the food was amazing. Hot food, which in a country where the food is mostly cold before it gets to your table says a lot!!! Highly recommend.
It's really a hole in the wall, do not expect any interior at all. Best as a quick snack or a takeaway. The quality of food is amazing for this price.
UVA is a great spot for any night. Cozy atmosphere, great food, great wine. I have been with friends to drink and munch on apps and with dates for dinners. Good for either type of night.

From the joke-telling doorman to the unique dishes, this is the place for brunch. I had the spinach and mushroom omelette...wonderful. My friends had several of the eggs benedict combos. If you want great food in a casual, friendly place, go to Queens Comfort.

After hearing a lot about this establishment we made it over for sandwiches one day.  I wasnt impressed.  I felt that it was more for the grad students.  Sandwiches were overpriced.  The interior is beautiful though, if we had to go back I would but there are plenty of other choices.
If you are late for your reservation, be prepared to suck it up and head to the bar and wait up to an hour for another table.

We stopped over for a pre-theater drink and "nibble". The menu is humble, but not at all bad (the lamb sliders were particularly good!). Good selection of drinks (including beers). Tables tend to wobble quite a bit, and the service is a bit slow, but still, worth trying out.

This place is a very cramped hole in the whole with seating maybe for ten or less people but the atmosphere was wonderful as was the service and food. Vegetable Muffalatta and Grass (Roasted Beets and Butternut Squash) Cheeky sandwiches were just wonderful as well as their buttermilk biscuits. My significant other had immensely enjoyed the Fried Chicken on a Biscuit Cheeky sandwich. Beignets were also very good but kind of small. Unfortunately they were out of Cafe Du Monde coffee but did have a nice supply of Louisiana potato chips and soft drinks. We will definitely be back to try other menu items in the future. Note that portions may be small but pricing is definitely affordable.

I assure you that I've tried pizza in many places and spaces and have to say that this is my absolute favorite. Between the sauce and crust, it's truly a magical experience. I prefer the white pizza, but I've tried their veggie concoctions and they are also quite good. That and the garlic knots are good to boot! You can't go wrong with this place (unless you just HAVE to sit down and eat your slice/s... then this place might not be for you.)

Great atmosphere in the back yard, candles, wine and great food. Their pasta is amazing, and I can't imagine one going wrong with any of their menu choices. The quality and preparation of the pasta was excellent, in my opinion. Bread and olive oil to start are good and tasty, and the ravioli was yummy as well. The tiramisu was served in a cup, which did not make for the nicest presentation and it was on the smaller side, but it was satisfying. ion. The prices are not out of line for quality NYC meals, but that just means it's an appreciable hit in the wallet.
Good for lunches. Nothing exceptional but everything you need from a low maintenance lunch is there. Pizzas are good. Pastas not so much. Service was ok.

Was able to finally came to this place to eat. Few times before was only for drinks and this place gets busy. prepare to wait. The cocktails here are very delicious, which made the wait seems shorter.  Most of my friends tried their burgers and they were all very satisfied, I ordered the seafood, don't know why, it came out good as well. I know this supposed to be the west village gem, and I can finally check off my list !

Had the spaghetti Bolognese and my friend had a prosciutto sandwich. Both were excellent and service was quick. Keep in mind: No Diet Coke and no separate checks. Looks like a great dinner menu as well as a nice Lunch Specials selection.

Bohemian is one of my favourite restaurants in New York. The concept, the atmosphere, the food- everything my taste.The fact that not too many people know about it (yet, and hopefully remains that way). We didn't order the tasting menu as we wanted to pick our own dishes. Everything there was so yummy- especially the Japanese steak, and it comes with sweet potatoes (my favourite!). Another favourite was the uni croquettes. Apart from the food, they also have amazing cocktails, really enjoyable dinner as always.
The food at Jungsik truly is art. Every plate is both visually beautiful and stunningly good to eat. Coming here is an experience not to be missed. Most highly recommended.

Loved everything we ordered. Rabbit, tomato pasta, halibut, fried zucchini and eggplant. Pasta was cooked al dente and thats what made it perfect. The service was good and the place was busy. Dessert was nice too. I feel portions are a little small but other than that we had a fun. Will definitely return.

The ricotta pancakes and the Moroccan scramble looked to be the favorites so I got the scramble. It was light, flavorful, and delicious. The avocado and chick peas were a delicious addition. Although the pancakes looked amazing I rarely saw anyone finish because they were so enormous. I had no problem finishing my entire plate.

I love going to this place. The food is really awesome and the prices are great. Although I have to admit I almost always order the same thing: a bowl of whatever soup they have (always so amazing) and the roast chicken, mozzarella, arugula and spicy mayo panini. I've tried to order other panini's but always go back to this one-its just so good! The beets with baby arugula, goat cheese and toasted walnut isalata is also amazing. When it isn't too cold out, they have a nice (although small) outdoor area to sit.

This sandwich was very good. I ordered it with bacon. Lots of bacon on the sandwich. I took most of it off. Also had the peach bellini -really hit the spot! Cute quaint restaurant. Friendly wait staff.

The meal was fine. Had I not had better Indian food in Philly, it would have gotten 3 stars. Hubby and I shared Papdi chaat, lamb korma, and garlic naan. The chaat seemed unusually watery and lacked serious depth of flavor.  Lamb korma was good, though the lamb could have been softer. Naan was not crispy and garlic was undercooked. Friendly service. Idk, the food just seemed to kinda just ... Exist. The rice wasn't floral or anything, and was mushy.  I guess it's in a good location, and is better than Tiffin. But make the travel to the Northeast for tastier Indian food. Won't be back to Ekta.
We loved our brunch here. The portions were large, for us more then enough to share one. Also the brunch cocktail was a good deal. Loved it, would go there again!
Stopped here for a family breakfast the service and food were both excellent. Only downside was a slightly limited menu if you want something without eggs.

The food was very very good. I had the Flounder (Sautéed filets topped with crab meat and served with parsley-lemon butter sauce, accompanied by ginger fried rice). The service was excellent and the atmosphere was cozy. The view is not the greatest, but I can live with that. I have recommended this Restaurant to everyone I know.
The Post Office is a friendly place. The staff is always professional and the food is great. This is a great local spot for a burger and a beer, and it is also appropriate for children.

I hate any place that does not take reservations. I find it incredibly annoying and unnecessary. The hosts here are also annoying in a condescending/hispter kind of way. Also, the service is bad. The people that work here come off as if they feel like they are saving the world by working here. Other than this, the food is extremely delicious (so much so that it outweighs the bad service/experience otherwise). Obviously the food is very unhealthy, perhaps excessively so- one of those places where there is butter, salt, and fat added to anything and everything. I'm surprised there wasn't a stick of butter in my water. That said, it was one of the best tasting cheeseburgers I have had in my life. It was out of this world.

This is a tiny restaurant with a big heart. Great food and ambiance with a twist. Spicy ketchup, outdoor seating and enclosed patio. Serves vegetarian and Moroccan specialties but also has wonderful breakfast served all day. Plus at a fair price. Good wait staff. I will go back.

I visited Cafe Mogador for brunch one Sunday. The menu has a number of good dishes. The food is very good, with interested Mediterranean-style choices. Like most brunch spots in Williamsburg, the cafe was full of people and had a really upbeat atmosphere. Great experience overall.

Stumbled across the malt house for a drink and some food and I was not disapointed!!! Great drink selection, good food, good atmosphere. Guy serving us was really helpful when choosing drinks & food! Quality place would certainly recommend it!!!
Tried the huge slices with some of my friends as soon as we landed. We were all not disappointed, just wished they were all over the world!

A great casual spot for delicious and inexpensive food that you can eat on the go. Everyone in my family enjoys themselves when we visit. The empanadas range from savory to sweet and their homemade dipping sauce has a great kick.

Came here for brunch and  was pleased to find a place that had a good vibe and a menu that showed creativity beyond the usual fare found at most places. What was nice is that the dishes werent creative just for the sake of being different they really showed culinary skills and thought behind them. A small but comfortable place and friendly servers. Service is on the relaxed side so if you're in a rush you wont be happy but if you want a nice leisurely conversation and meal this is the place. Coffee is good and strong and they also serve a variety of health juices. I did an experiment whereas I ordered a small pizza from Grimaldi's and one from Juliana's, the original maker of Grimaldi's pizza. Keep in mind I had no narrative bias, I really wanted to see which was the better pizza. And the difference was striking. Grimaldi's tasted like supermarket pizza and made me yearn for real NY pizza. I was laying blame on the style of the pizza. Then I went to Juliana's. Interestingly, small pizza with identical "look".But that's where the similarities ended. I was blown away by Juliana's Pizza. Every part of the pizza offered a complimenting flavor. The crust was toasty yet malleable whereas Grimaldi's was doughy and powdery. What's the point of the oven if that's how you serve it? Juliana's cheese was scrumptious and alive with flavors whereas Grimaldis tasted like mozzarella alone. The sauce at Gromaldi's was watered down, at Juliana's it had a rich flavor. Even the basil leaf on the Juliana pizza offered an interesting unique flavor while the Grimaldi's leaf might as well been an ornament. It tasted like  over cooked lettuce.I found a respect for the style of Pizza at Juliana's.

I just thought we should have been treated better. So to start at the end... I ended up having a cold pork bun (my wife snuck it out for me) at the hotel and it was yummy.  It would have been better warm.  I also ended up sitting outside of the restaurant on the concrete with my 5 year old, eating a slice of pizza and watching an episode of The Office on my phone. We had bookmarked this place (we were on vacation in the city) and were excited to come.  We were able to get a table pretty quickly (it was that odd 3 o'clock hour) and upon getting there told the lady bringing us back that one of my kids would not be eating there.  We were holding his slice of pizza in plain sight along with a bag of chips.   We sat and the waiter asked if we were ready to order and we told him we'd need a minute and once again, let him know that one my kids would not be eating (he was already eating his bag of chips). Another waiter came by and we ordered some buns before ordering anything else.  He returned to give us some plates and we told him, again, one of our kids would not be eating with us and we brought his food (by now it's on the table in very, very, very plain site). A few minutes later, the buns come out and the waiter tells us, "We have a strict policy for no outside food." I understand the policy kind of.  It is the right of the restaurant to have this policy.  My issues with that day was, WHY ARE YOU TELLING US NOW!!!  We have ordered.  We are sitting.  We've had 3 employees aware of the Pizza on the table.  Since nobody enforced the policy until we ordered... can you cut us some slack?  Can you cut my child some slack?  We asked for an exception because we were not told until the food came out (we did not keep it a secret b/c we believe that's not fair to the restaurant) about the policy.  We were told again the same. So I ended up outside on the sidewalk eating a slice of pizza with my son trying to explain to him what happened and why.  Not easy to explain to a 5 year old.  I told him I was sorry that his Dad was angry, but not at him.  I told him the restaurant is not wrong in not letting him eat pizza there.  I told him there is nothing wrong with him eating anything different.  That's about as much as I could explain to him. I respect the policy.  I don't respect the restaurant and how they handled their own policy.

This place is a very cramped hole in the whole with seating maybe for ten or less people but the atmosphere was wonderful as was the service and food. Vegetable Muffalatta and Grass (Roasted Beets and Butternut Squash) Cheeky sandwiches were just wonderful as well as their buttermilk biscuits. My significant other had immensely enjoyed the Fried Chicken on a Biscuit Cheeky sandwich. Beignets were also very good but kind of small. Unfortunately they were out of Cafe Du Monde coffee but did have a nice supply of Louisiana potato chips and soft drinks. We will definitely be back to try other menu items in the future. Note that portions may be small but pricing is definitely affordable.

I visited Cafe Mogador for brunch one Sunday. The menu has a number of good dishes. The food is very good, with interested Mediterranean-style choices. Like most brunch spots in Williamsburg, the cafe was full of people and had a really upbeat atmosphere. Great experience overall.

Had the spaghetti Bolognese and my friend had a prosciutto sandwich. Both were excellent and service was quick. Keep in mind: No Diet Coke and no separate checks. Looks like a great dinner menu as well as a nice Lunch Specials selection.

Loved everything we ordered. Rabbit, tomato pasta, halibut, fried zucchini and eggplant. Pasta was cooked al dente and thats what made it perfect. The service was good and the place was busy. Dessert was nice too. I feel portions are a little small but other than that we had a fun. Will definitely return.

t's very small but in a cosy way that was just perfect. Lovely staff and the food was amazing. Hot food, which in a country where the food is mostly cold before it gets to your table says a lot!!! Highly recommend.

The ricotta pancakes and the Moroccan scramble looked to be the favorites so I got the scramble. It was light, flavorful, and delicious. The avocado and chick peas were a delicious addition. Although the pancakes looked amazing I rarely saw anyone finish because they were so enormous. I had no problem finishing my entire plate.

This sandwich was very good. I ordered it with bacon. Lots of bacon on the sandwich. I took most of it off. Also had the peach bellini -really hit the spot! Cute quaint restaurant. Friendly wait staff.

The pork and duck are Okay. The soup has a horrible funky flavor (lack thereof). The service is even bad for Chinatown. The waiters just do not pay attention to you. Our friend had the congee which was actually good. We won't be back, and they won't miss our presence either. Life goes on here..
If you are late for your reservation, be prepared to suck it up and head to the bar and wait up to an hour for another table.

A great casual spot for delicious and inexpensive food that you can eat on the go. Everyone in my family enjoys themselves when we visit. The empanadas range from savory to sweet and their homemade dipping sauce has a great kick.

Sugar cured bacon. Bellini. Blueberry pancakes with warm maple butter. Pure heaven. We arrived a few minutes before they opened for dinner so we didn't have to wait. I had read great reviews about this place and begged my friends to make the trek with me. We were not disappointed.

Great atmosphere in the back yard, candles, wine and great food. Their pasta is amazing, and I can't imagine one going wrong with any of their menu choices. The quality and preparation of the pasta was excellent, in my opinion. Bread and olive oil to start are good and tasty, and the ravioli was yummy as well. The tiramisu was served in a cup, which did not make for the nicest presentation and it was on the smaller side, but it was satisfying. ion. The prices are not out of line for quality NYC meals, but that just means it's an appreciable hit in the wallet.
We loved our brunch here. The portions were large, for us more then enough to share one. Also the brunch cocktail was a good deal. Loved it, would go there again!

Beautifully cooked and presented dishes with attentive service. Eggs Benedict was yummy and the unusual herb based Brunch cocktail just the ticket for a lazy Sunday holiday morning. Not the cheapest, but justified by combining cost of breakfast and dinner!

Whether it's pouring or blizzarding or hot as heck ... you're sure to find a line. Mixed platter + extra white sauce + just the right amount of hot sauce = perfection. Only first-timers drizzle on the hot sauce thinking they can handle it. But like the thousands of reviews before me, THIS AIN'T YOUR ORDINARY HOT SAUCE. Take it easy or else you'll suffer the next morning... Whatever you're doing guys, keep it up! Will be back here every time I visit!

We went on a Sunday evening and set on the bar. The place has great atmosphere and accordingly decorated. The food was great, the best tapas I have ever had. We just kept ordering food until the paella with sea food was just perfect, really the best I had. With two pints of Spanish bear, we had great enjoyable dinner. This place is highly recommended.

What a terrific experience! Originally planning to drop by for a beer to check out Beehive Oven, our party of 3 stayed a couple of hours enjoying the great food, drink and company! Delicious food with a Southern flair and cold, cold brewskis were enhanced by the warm atmosphere, original artwork and friendly and attentive owners and staff. No pretension - just fun!

We stopped over for a pre-theater drink and "nibble". The menu is humble, but not at all bad (the lamb sliders were particularly good!). Good selection of drinks (including beers). Tables tend to wobble quite a bit, and the service is a bit slow, but still, worth trying out.
This is a small place with an incredible vibe. The food is fantastic. I had the chefs tasting menu and every dish was on point. A must try!
vegan small plates and drink a few blocks from my work... woo hoo! this is my go to date spot in the area. not that i get dates, but if i did, i imagine this is where i would take them.

The meal was fine. Had I not had better Indian food in Philly, it would have gotten 3 stars. Hubby and I shared Papdi chaat, lamb korma, and garlic naan. The chaat seemed unusually watery and lacked serious depth of flavor.  Lamb korma was good, though the lamb could have been softer. Naan was not crispy and garlic was undercooked. Friendly service. Idk, the food just seemed to kinda just ... Exist. The rice wasn't floral or anything, and was mushy.  I guess it's in a good location, and is better than Tiffin. But make the travel to the Northeast for tastier Indian food. Won't be back to Ekta.

This brunch was excellent! Eggs with Polenta. Service was great and friendly not the typical american friendly - just friendly, I had the feeling she really cared. Not a cheap restaurant. A nice atmosphere, growded. Reservation is needed for the typical eating hours.

We have eaten here many times before and invited friends for their first visit. We have never been disappointed. Service and food are always exceptional. Owner truly want you to enjoy your meal. For an appetizer, try the artichoke fritters with gorgonzola dip...yummy..and a large enough portion to share!

Stumbled across the malt house for a drink and some food and I was not disapointed!!! Great drink selection, good food, good atmosphere. Guy serving us was really helpful when choosing drinks & food! Quality place would certainly recommend it!!!
Great food and wine! Waitress was super helpful on recommending wine and interpreting dishes. Lovely back area. Would come again.

You pick your choice of meatballs (including veggie ones), your sauce and your sides and you are ready for a delicious treat. The food is tasty, freshly made and very good value for money.The service was excellent and friendly. It stays open late if you want a good meal after bar hopping.
Went there with my friend, large portions for NY. Food tasted amazing! Prices are High nevertheless. Ambiente is also very nice! Modern and cozy. Nice place to go!

We were seated in the back and had a leisurely lovely 2.5 hour meal. Goose martini was well chilled. The celery root soup appetizer and flounder entree were delicious. Chocolate dessert was heavenly. Wait staff were attentive without being intrusive. Clean restaurant.
